مُقَشَّبٌ Poison with which medicaments [or drugs] are mixed to render it potent. (Ham p. 331.) See also قَشِيبٌ, first sentence. ―
-b2- And, (M, K,) or مُقَشَّبُ الحَسَبِ, (S,) (tropical:) A man whose grounds of pretension to respect are mixed (S, M, K, * TA) with ignobleness. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
